title: HUD coin counter does not update after collecting a coin
observed: After moving right then dashing right, state coins=1 but HUD shows Coins 0/5.
expected: HUD should show Coins 1/5 when a coin is collected.

title: Movement key in same tick as pause still moves the player
observed: pause+right moves player to (2,1) despite pause taking effect immediately; rest of tick input should be ignored.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately and ignores remaining input, so player should not move.

title: Spikes underflow score instead of losing points
observed: With score 0, hitting spikes results in score 65136 or similar instead of staying at 0 (score never goes below).
expected: Score should never go below 0; spikes should reduce to 0 at minimum.

title: HUD time does not update after pause resume
observed: After pause then resume, state timeLeft=299 but HUD shows Time 300.
expected: HUD should always show current timeLeft.

title: Key lost on death when collected in same tick as enemy hit
observed: Collecting a key and being hit in the same tick loses both a life and the key; state shows keys=0 after respawn.
expected: Player keeps collected items, including keys picked up in the same tick.

title: First movement key wins instead of last when multiple movement keys pressed in same tick
observed: With tokens right+down, player moves right to (2,1) instead of down to (1,2).
expected: Only the last movement key pressed in a tick counts, so the player should move down.

title: Restart level leaves game paused instead of running
observed: After pause then click btn-restart, mode remains paused; game does not resume running.
expected: Restart level should reset the level and the game should be running again straight away.
